name: If You Give a Chicken Ramen
source:
We know what happens with moose and muffins, mice and cookies... what about chickens and ramen? Only one way to find out!

[From [url=https://elfybean.itch.io/if-you-give-a-chicken-ramen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们知道，给驼鹿松饼、给老鼠饼干，会发生什么……可如果给鸡一碗拉面呢？只有亲自试试，才能知道！

[摘自[url=https://elfybean.itch.io/if-you-give-a-chicken-ramen]itch.io[/url]]
